Prepare your raid team

Choose a hero, then its evolution. All available nodes, blessing, limit breaks, weapon rolls and EX engraving are assumed maxed for that selection. Heroes without a Myth entry and their EX weapons cap at level 130; Myth-capable heroes cap at 150. Change the weapon for off-element teams.

DURING THE FIGHT

Active team buffs

Choose bonuses already active at the moment of the hit. The list follows your heroes, evolution, equipped items and leader. Weapon and leader skill sources require that hero to lead. Permanent party buffs are already included.

How these temporary bonuses are applied

These are snapshots of an active buff, not an automatic rotation: using a weapon skill does not automatically enable its effect or expire it later. Do not enable a buff for the hit that triggers it unless it applies before that hit. Durations come from the records. Within the same buff group and stat, the strongest selected contribution applies; different groups add to their corresponding stat multiplier. Native conditional damage passives instead multiply the hit damage and do not change prepared ATK or UI DPS. A recipient you choose for an unresolved script is a manual assumption. Buffs with unresolved values or unsupported effect types are not listed; absence does not prove a hero has no other effects.

FROM STATS TO DAMAGE

Your damage estimates

Read formula evidence ↗

Average means the expected result over critical rolls. “All critical” assumes every listed hit crits. Cast totals assume every hit lands. Each attack starts from your selected pre-existing boss effects. Traced on-hit debuffs are then applied between its hits; Beth’s EX reduction starts after her first normal hit. Other effect timing remains manual unless explicitly traced. No team-wide total is shown because these attacks do not occur at the same rate.
